p9_b3.ocr: The year 2022 marked a notable increase in roaming revenue, with the figure reaching 1750 CNY million, reflecting a strong rebound from previous years. This resurgence is indicative of the growing demand for international travel and communication services as borders reopened and consumer confidence returned. Furthermore, the data highlights that in 2020, the roaming revenue was recorded at 1300 CNY million, illustrating how the sector has navigated through challenging times.

p9_b4.ocr: In parallel, the table provides important insights into customer engagement metrics, including the number of active roaming users, which stood at 58M in July and saw a slight increase to 55M by January of the following year. These metrics not only underscore the increasing adoption of roaming services but also signal a shift in consumer preferences towards more connected travel experiences. As the telecommunications landscape continues to evolve, these trends will be vital for stakeholders in understanding market dynamics and strategizing for future growth in the Asia-Pacific region.
